name: Weight Converter
description: Convert weight and mass between milligrams, grams, kilograms, metric tons, ounces, pounds, stone, and US tons instantly.

faq.question: How accurate are these conversions?
faq.answer: Every unit is defined by its internationally standardized exact factor in kilograms (a pound is defined as exactly 0.45359237 kg, for instance), so results are as accurate as floating-point arithmetic allows.

faq.question: Is a US ton the same as a metric ton?
faq.answer: No — a US (short) ton is 2,000 pounds (907.18474 kg), while a metric ton is exactly 1,000 kg (about 2,204.6 pounds). The UK "long ton" (2,240 lb) is a third, different unit not included here since it's rarely used outside historical/UK-specific contexts.
